# Washly MTL

> Washly is a laundry pickup and delivery service in Montréal, Québec, Canada, with a 24-hour turnaround. We pick up your laundry at your door, wash, dry and fold it, and deliver it back within 24 hours.

## Service
- Wash & fold laundry service (everyday clothing, bed linens, towels).
- Free pickup and delivery across all Montréal neighborhoods.
- 24-hour turnaround, guaranteed.
- Eco-friendly, premium detergents. Hypoallergenic options available.
- Fully insured, live order tracking.
- We do NOT accept dry-clean-only garments, leather/suede, or heavily soiled items.

## Pricing (CAD)
- Standard bag (~20 lbs / 9 kg): $34.99
- Large bag (~30 lbs / 14 kg): $39.99
- Monthly plans: Solo 2 bags $75, Popular 4 bags $119, Household 6 bags $165.
- Free pickup & delivery. Extended delivery +$4.99 for addresses over 30 minutes away.

## How to order
- Book on the website: https://washlymtl.com/#book
- Or download the iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/washly-mtl/id6761146858

## Contact
- Support: support@washlymtl.com
- Business/B2B: partnerships@washlymtl.com
- Hours: 7 days a week, 9 AM – 9 PM

## Reviews
- Rated 5.0 out of 5 from 16 Google reviews.

## Areas served
Le Plateau, Mile End, Ville-Marie, Griffintown, Verdun, NDG, Outremont, Rosemont, Hochelaga, Villeray, Saint-Henri, Westmount, Ahuntsic, LaSalle, Côte-des-Neiges, Old Montréal, and all other Montréal neighborhoods.
